title: Free Walking Tour Santa Barbara
specs: Meet architect Jeff Shelton in his studio on the Old Town Tour
Learn about Santa Barbara's history from Native Americans to modern times
Explore the Funk Zone's wine tasting rooms, brew pubs, and art galleries
gap: Duration not explicitly stated, inferred as a couple of hours from reviews
blurb: Guests join guided walking tours covering Santa Barbara's marina history, the Funk Zone's wine and art scene, and Old Town's architecture including visits to architect Jeff Shelton's studio. Tours include historical photos and storytelling. The tours are informative and engaging, suitable for visitors and locals.
highlights: Meet architect Jeff Shelton in his studio on the Old Town Tour
Learn about Santa Barbara's history from Native Americans to modern times
Explore the Funk Zone's wine tasting rooms, brew pubs, and art galleries

quotes.author: Alicia Ekberg
quotes.text: My husband and I took the Waterfront Tour late July with Craig. Although we've visited Santa Barbara many times, we learned so much about it's history that we didn't already know. In fact we liked it so much we took the Old Town architectural tour (again with Craig) the next day. We had previously seen the Abblit house but didn't know about all the other buildings that Jeff Shelton had designed and so felt extremely lucky to meet him and see many of his models in his workshop. We highly recommend the tour and highly recommend Craig. He is very knowledgeable and a great story teller.

quotes.author: michael kalouche
quotes.text: My wife and I, living in New York but originally from France and Costa Rica, did the Waterfront Tour with John, and it was one of the best tours we’ve ever had! John seems to know everything about Santa Barbara and clearly loves sharing the history and stories of his hometown. He made the tour both informative and really enjoyable. We only wish we’d had more time in Santa Barbara — we would definitely have done his other two tours as well. Highly recommended!

quotes.author: patriciakr2018
quotes.text: Free Walking Tour of Old Town Santa Barbara We took the Free Walking Tour of Old Town Santa Barbara with Craig today! Enjoyed learning about the history and seeing the old pictures. Craig was a great story teller and answered our questions. It was amazing to learn about Jeff Shelton’s artistic style of art! Loved seeing his office and more of his designs. We went to see several more buildings on our own! We would highly recommend this tour AND Craig!!

quotes.author: Yolanda Garnier
quotes.text: We took the Old Town Santa Barbara walking tour with John and thoroughly enjoyed every minute of it. The tour was fun, entertaining, and filled with fascinating historical facts that brought the area's rich history to life. John was an engaging guide who made the experience both informative and enjoyable. We highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting Santa Barbara, and we look forward to joining the other two walking tours in the future!

quotes.author: Julie Armstrong
quotes.text: John led a super-informative tour revealing the history of downtown through its changes and progress over the years. I actually thought we were signing up for a typical historic tour so was pleasantly surprised when we began heading down alleys and side streets which bore their own history. I would highly recommend this tour to both visitors and local residents.

quotes.author: DLS01
quotes.text: A great way to start your Santa Barbara visit We enjoyed a fabulous Old Town tour with John. Loved hearing about the origins of Santa Barbara and especially seeing significant historic buildings from the Spanish Andalusian era. A highlight was meeting the architect Jeff Shelton in his studio after viewing several of his Gaudi-esque buildings. Highly recommend!
